transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

I… I’m here because things at work haven’t been right. On this environmental modeling contract, I’m pretty sure some people have been tracking my revisions and putting errors into the datasets. It makes it look like I can’t lead the work.

My wife and some junior analysts say it’s probably just version-control mistakes, but… I don’t think that’s all it is.
Have you had any periods, lasting several days or longer, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had stretches where I sleep badly, but not where I felt… elated or full of energy for days. Not like that.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear, or seen things that others didn't see?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t seen anything like that. Sometimes I’ll think I heard something, but it’s usually just the house or the office, I guess. Nothing I could really say was… a voice.

Have you always tended to be wary and suspicious of other people's motives throughout your life, or is this concern about your coworkers something that started more recently and feels different from how you've usually thought?

I’ve always been… careful about people’s motives, I guess. But this with the project feels different. The part about them tracking my revisions and putting errors in there… that’s been going on in my mind pretty solidly for maybe two months.
Aside from this concern about your coworkers and the project, how are things going for you generally—are you managing your other work tasks, home life, and relationships the way you normally would?

Not really the way I normally would, no. I’ve… fallen behind on some modeling deliverables, enough that they moved parts of the contract to other people. And I’m supposed to be helping the junior analysts, but I haven’t been much use lately.

At home I mostly keep to myself. My wife has to nudge me to keep up with basic things.

Besides this concern about your coworkers, have you noticed a general loss of interest or motivation in things you used to care about, or found it harder to express emotions or organize your thoughts clearly?

Yeah… I guess so. I don’t really start things anymore.

I’ll sit at my desk for hours, or out in the garage with the telescope still covered, and I know I used to care about that stuff. Hiking, astronomy nights… helping the younger analysts. I just don’t feel much pull to do it, or to talk to people. It’s kind of… flat.
How long have you been feeling this flat, unmotivated, and withdrawn—did it start before the concerns about your coworkers began, or around the same time?

It was before the coworker thing, I think. The flatness… that started after I got put in charge of that bigger environmental modeling contract. So… a little over two years ago. Two years and a couple months, maybe.
Have you noticed times when your thoughts feel jumbled or hard to organize, or when other people say your speech is difficult to follow?

I don’t know. Sometimes I lose my place when I’m explaining something, but I’m not sure if it’s more than just… being tired or distracted.

Nobody’s really said I’m hard to follow, not directly.
I’m not really sure. I mean, I lose my train of thought sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s anything unusual. No one’s told me I’m not making sense.
Over these past two years, have you noticed any changes in your basic self-care—like keeping up with showering, grooming, or your usual routines—compared to before?

Yeah… some. I still do the basics, mostly, but not like before.

My wife has to nudge me a lot—getting up, showering, keeping a routine. At home I mostly just stay to myself. And work’s gotten behind too… the modeling deliverables. They’ve had to reassign parts of the contract, and I’m not much help to the junior analysts lately.
Have you been using any alcohol, recreational drugs, or new medications, or have you had any medical issues like thyroid problems or head injuries, around the time these symptoms began?

Not that I can think of. I don’t really use drugs, and alcohol isn’t… it’s not much of a thing for me. I haven’t had a head injury or anything like that that I know of.

No new medical issue comes to mind.
